The '''Activv1 Riot Shield''' was a one-[[Meter/Legends|meter]]-long [[Shield (physical armor)/Legends|shield]] made by the [[Drearian Defense Conglomerate/Legends|Drearian Defense Conglomerate]] with the capacity to [[Stun/Legends|stun]] others. It was made of layered metal and one-way mirrored [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]], and had a handle with an activation stud to initiate the shield's stun charge. It also possessed a small notch into which the muzzle of a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] could be placed.
